title: Shared coefficient morphism for raw over pullback
statement: For Λ, W and G as in [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-over-complex] and f:A→B in Over W, construct a map f^*((B^*G)[0])→(A^*G)[0]. It is the hom component of the fixed single-complex comparison, followed by the single functor applied to the inverse of the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism f^*B^*G≅A^*G [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The source and target use the shared actual single complexes of [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-over-complex].

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1, fixed cohomology comparison and inverse-image composition

The degree zero single complex of a sheaf pulled back through composed scheme morphisms and the canonical coefficient identification
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits about Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp and structure-sheaf pullback coherence; none about this fixed small-etale module-sheaf construction.
DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor, singleFunctorιIso and singleFunctors. The construction uses singleFunctor directly.
singleFunctor is the existing Mathlib single complex; no raw-over helper is named there. The helper shares the existing construction and adds no notion.
